title: Olivia Dean, BINI lead LaLaLa Fest Manila 2027 acts
summary: Grammy-winning singer Olivia Dean will headline LaLaLa Fest Manila 2027 on January 14 at the Philippine Arena, together with Nation’s Girl Group BINI.
